result.instructions: Tools for e-Courier, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Where is order 5648172 and who is the driver?"; "Quote a same-day pickup at 2251 Orange Blossom Trail, Orlando and delivery to 2253 Orange Blossom Trail for customer ALPHA."; "Which orders is driver D001 carrying right now?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes e-Courier data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ecourier_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ecourier_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ecourier_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. ecourier_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ecourier_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One delivery order with everything e-Courier holds: status (N new, A assigned, X deleted), customer, stops and their pickup/delivery times and POD names, pieces, jobs and drivers, fees, events and notifications. Give exactly one of order_number, order_id, auth (the customer's authorization code) or reference (a piece reference; add customer_code to narrow it). Signature images are not returned. GetJsonOrder.

order_number.description: The order number shown in e-Courier.

reference.description: A piece reference / barcode on the order.

customer_code.description: Customer code; useful together with reference.

tools.name: ecourier_get_order_fees
tools.title: Get order fees
tools.description: The fee lines (what was charged for the delivery: base rate, fuel, waiting time and so on) of one order, by internal order id. GetOrderFees.

order_id.description: Internal order id (the OrderID from ecourier_get_order).

tools.name: ecourier_quote_order
tools.title: Quote an order
tools.description: Price and availability for a delivery WITHOUT creating it: e-Courier applies the customer's rates to the stops and pieces and returns the order with the quoted amount. Supply a customer code, pickup/delivery stops and optional pieces. Nothing is saved and nobody is notified. QuoteOrder.

customer_code.description: e-Courier customer (billing account) code the order is for, as in e-Courier.

service.description: Service name configured in e-Courier, e.g. Route or Scheduled.

caller.description: Name of the person who placed the order.

caller_phone.description: Phone of the person who placed the order.

other_reference.description: Your own reference for the order (PO number etc.).

auth.description: Customer authorization / reference code, if the account uses one.

pieces.description: The items being moved. Each is linked to the pickup stop and the delivery stop.

count.description: Number of items in this piece line (default 1).

weight.description: Weight of the piece line, in the account's weight unit.

name.description: Company or person at the stop.

state.description: State or province code, e.g. FL.

scheduled.description: Local date and time the stop is scheduled (pickup ready time or delivery due time), e.g. 2026-11-13T17:00.

timezone.description: Timezone code of the scheduled time, e.g. EST.

note.description: Instructions for the driver at this stop.

stops.description: At least one pickup (P) and one delivery (D) stop, in route order.

tools.name: ecourier_get_customer_by_code
tools.title: Get customer by code
tools.description: A customer (billing account) by its e-Courier customer code: id, name and address. GetCustomerByCode.

tools.name: ecourier_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer by id
tools.description: The full customer record by internal customer id: contact, address, credit status and limit, balance, billing settings. Card numbers and passwords are never returned. GetCustomerById.

tools.name: ecourier_find_customer_by_phone
tools.title: Find customer by phone
tools.description: Look up a customer by phone number (useful when a caller rings in): id, name and address. GetCustomerInfoFromPhoneNumber.

tools.name: ecourier_list_customer_ship_tos
tools.title: List customer ship-to addresses
tools.description: The saved ship-to (stop) addresses of a customer, by internal customer id, or one ship-to by its id. Give exactly one. GetCustomerShipTo.

customer_id.description: Internal customer id: all its saved addresses.

tools.name: ecourier_list_drivers
tools.title: List active drivers
tools.description: Every active driver: id, code, name and site. Optionally only one site (multi-site accounts). GetDrivers.

site_id.description: Only drivers of this site id.

tools.name: ecourier_get_driver
tools.title: Get driver
tools.description: Driver records with their vehicles and file names (never SSN or tax ids). With driver_id or driver_code one driver; with neither, every active and inactive driver. GetDriver.

tools.name: ecourier_get_driver_orders
tools.title: Get a driver's current orders
tools.description: What a driver is carrying right now: the open orders on the driver's manifest (customer, pickup and delivery names, delivery zip, ready and due times), found by driver code or by the driver's phone number. Give exactly one. GetDriverInfoFromDriverCode / GetDriverInfoFromDriverPhone.

tools.name: ecourier_list_skills
tools.title: List driver skills
tools.description: The master list of active driver skills (for example HAZMAT) with ids. GetSkills.

tools.name: ecourier_get_driver_skills
tools.title: Get a driver's skills
tools.description: The skills assigned to one driver, by driver id or driver code (give exactly one). GetDriverSkills.

tools.name: ecourier_get_manifest
tools.title: Get manifest
tools.description: One driver manifest (the route a driver runs for a day) with all its job stops: sequence, addresses, status, pieces and weight. GetManifest.

tools.name: ecourier_list_driver_manifests
tools.title: List a driver's manifests
tools.description: The manifests of one driver between two dates, with their job stops. Default status filter is active (A). GetManifestsByDriver.

tools.name: ecourier_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: Invoices in an invoice date range (invoice_start_date and invoice_end_date are both required, at most 31 days apart: e-Courier rejects anything else). Optionally narrow by customer code and by a last-changed range. GetInvoice.

invoice_end_date.description: Invoice date to, yyyy-mm-dd. Required, at most 31 days after the start.

tools.name: ecourier_get_invoice_fees
tools.title: Get invoice fees
tools.description: The fee lines of one invoice, by invoice id (the id from ecourier_list_invoices). GetInvoiceFees.

tools.name: ecourier_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: Customer payments received in a payment date range (payment_start_date and payment_end_date are both required, at most 10 days apart: e-Courier rejects anything else). Optionally narrow by customer code, check number or payment id. GetPayment.

payment_end_date.description: Payment date to, yyyy-mm-dd. Required, at most 10 days after the start.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with e-Courier
prompts.description: What you can do with e-Courier here, with example requests to try.
